$comment: Shared agent-eval registry. Each key is a pipeline agent; the value declares WHERE its gold eval set lives, HOW to score it (label | artifact | produced_tests), which field of a row feeds the agent, and the pass threshold used as a CI gate. LABEL mode invokes the agent headless with tools disabled and exact-matches routing booleans. ARTIFACT mode copies the product-truth store and its bounded declared contract dependencies into a throwaway /tmp sandbox, invokes the WRITE-capable agent there (cwd=sandbox, LEAFCUTTER_REPO_ROOT=sandbox, so all writes stay contained), then scores the produced *.mock.json / *.flow.json with the deterministic assertions of TQ-200a-2-ii (schema-valid, entities-in-registry, extend-not-duplicate, referenced-records-exist, one acceptance_scenario per step/branch, id path-stable) plus an optional per-row LLM-judge rubric. All paths are relative to the repo root.

pt-classifier.notes: Booleans are the scored labels; outcome is derived from them via OUTCOME_BY_COMBO and reported as a secondary accuracy figure. Model pinned to haiku to match the pt-classifier template frontmatter. response_label_field names the sub-object of the model's returned JSON that holds the axes (pt-classifier's S4 contract nests them under 'expected'); omit or null it when an agent returns the axes at top level.

mock-data-author.notes: Runs in a per-row /tmp sandbox copy of docs/product-truth plus its declared contract dependencies. Deterministic assertions are the gate; the key check unique to this agent is extend-not-duplicate (single_canonical_dataset) — the validator does NOT enforce it. validator_clean is a DELTA gate (the agent must introduce no NEW validator errors vs the reconciled baseline), robust to a store a concurrent session is mid-editing. Model=opus per the template frontmatter. Threshold 0.66 = >=2/3 rows as the CI gate; 3/3 is the fully-wired bar. Flow targets must independently pass scoped contract validation; target errors and unavailable validation are never subtracted as baseline noise.

flow-author.notes: Per-row /tmp sandbox copy of docs/product-truth plus its declared contract dependencies. The GOLDEN row removes the gold track-an-order artifact (sandbox_prep.remove_artifacts) so the agent must reverse-engineer it. Assertions cover ordered steps, screens-resolve, one acceptance_scenario per step AND per branch, has_branch (the held-out journey requires an alternate path), and extend-not-duplicate for the negative add-vs-create row. validator_clean is a DELTA gate. Model=opus per the template frontmatter. Flow targets must independently pass scoped contract validation; target errors and unavailable validation are never subtracted as baseline noise.

restructuring-specialist.notes: INF-800f-1 arms 2 and 3. Label mode: the report's machine-readable skills_applied object (skill id -> bool) is scored on the complexity-reduction axis. The complexity row (scripts/planner.py, plan_batches, complexity 31, 30 allowed) expects true; the file-size row (120 measured lines to leave scripts/planner.py) expects false, so the skill is chosen by the demand and not applied on every engagement. Triggers are limited to the agent's own files (owner decision 2026-10-06). A live run needs model credentials; CI holds none, so the live run is the informational gate and the offline --self-test is the deterministic one.

test-writer.notes: TQ-200d-1 / TQ-200d-1-i. PRODUCED-TESTS mode: the agent writes tests and a completion report in a per-row git sandbox (the row's fixture project plus the scripts the template names, {{config.output_root}} rendered to the sandbox); the output is scored deterministically (fixture seeds the moved input, exact row and non-NULL counts, a seeded known value, test B red on a wrong result not at import) and the refresh-gate row's test half comes from the shared wrong-version runner (halves.test, halves.report). LOCAL ONLY (user decision 2026-09-28, KI-TQ-20260907): local_only true keeps this agent out of eval_selector's affected set and --check, and every payload carries run_context 'local'. --score-gold replays the recorded gold outputs under scripts/evals/sets/test-writer/recorded/ and makes no model call. A live run (python scripts/evals/run_agent_eval.py --agent test-writer) needs model credentials; the live before-score is deferred (OQ-11).

test-runner.notes: TQ-200d-4. LOCAL ONLY like test-writer. The test runner writes no files, so its rows are scored on its report and on the Bash commands of a stream-json transcript (capture_transcript true): the checker was run against the project, and no command carries a postgresql:// literal or a host, port or database flag. --score-gold replays scripts/evals/sets/test-runner/recorded/ with no model call.

sql-test-writer.notes: TQ-200d-2. PRODUCED-TESTS mode for the database test writer (Bash, Read, Edit, Write only: the sandbox has no sub-agents or skills). Three rows: a stored-procedure regression (observed only with a quoted verdict row, a wrong version in the to-run-later file), the empty-window database shape (the SQL counts processed rows and non-NULL values) and the no-test-database trap (every answer reasoned, both runs not run, the setting named, no claimed result). Every database address is the placeholder, so the checker reports invalid or not_configured and no row reaches a database. LOCAL ONLY: local_only true keeps this agent out of eval_selector's affected set and --check; every payload carries run_context 'local'. --score-gold replays scripts/evals/sets/sql-test-writer/recorded/ and makes no model call; the live before-score is deferred (OQ-11).

test-designer.notes: TQ-200d-3. PRODUCED-TESTS mode for the test designer (Bash, Read, Write, Edit only). The designer writes no test file: its output is the requirement record it edits in place (test_spec, test_design_authorship, test_design_opened_files), so each row's sandbox holds a one-record store (eval_store/) and the scorer reads the edited record. Three rows: a bug fix (must_catch names 'revert the fix' and a retry_due wrong version), a gate (one wrong version per condition plus 'the gate always allows') and the new-behaviour trap (any must_catch name or discrimination angle fails the row: neither a bug fix nor a gate). Condition tokens also match fixed word-sequence variants carried in the row spec. The bug fix / gate / neither judgement is read from the record fields (must_catch, angle discrimination), never from the reply. input_builder 'designer_eval' makes the live input the plan-feature dispatchTestDesign ingredients (ids, the verbatim design_prepass.py report, ac_store_path, test-design group only). LOCAL ONLY: local_only true keeps this agent out of eval_selector's affected set and --check; every payload carries run_context 'local'. --score-gold replays scripts/evals/sets/test-designer/recorded/ and makes no model call; the live before-score is deferred (OQ-11).

it-po.notes: BO-2500a-8-ii prompt proof, the WITH condition: the real template. Every row must write test_required false and a non-empty test_rationale (threshold 1.0). Informational, like the other live evals; with no credential the run reports 'no model credentials', not a score.

it-po-without-reason-rule.notes: BO-2500a-8-ii prompt proof, the WITHOUT condition: a stored byte copy of it-po.md from before the reason rule (never regenerated). It is expected to score BELOW threshold (test_required false alone); the proof holds only when it-po meets its threshold and this entry does not.
